zh: **思考行回放推理时不再拖慢页面**：推理窗口里的文字每 0.84 秒平滑上移一步，一步追到最新一行，正在思考的回合里页面保持流畅（本机实测：修复前单帧最长 470 毫秒、主线程阻塞 406 毫秒，修复后 29 秒内没有超过 100 毫秒的帧）。
en: **Replaying the reasoning in the thinking row no longer slows the page**: the text in the reasoning window glides up one step every 0.84 seconds, each step reaching the newest line, and the page stays smooth while the model thinks (measured locally: the longest frame went from 470 ms with 406 ms of main-thread blocking to no frame over 100 ms across 29 seconds).
